verdict.rationale: Checking an application's status from public pages is a fair question for a government immigration agency like AIMA, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a failed connection probe: TLS certificate verification failed and nothing on the host was fetched. No public status-lookup capability is documented, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
